authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Commander-independent mill (Painter's Servant/Grindstone) cut for Xander copies (decisions).
No generic Grixis cEDH replacement of the commander-first shell (decisions L17).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Graveyard hate stops the reanimation route to a seven-mana commander.
Rounding down can leave a card in a library.
Removal before attacking costs the mill trigger (though the dies trigger still hurts).

value.interaction: Free counters (Force of Will, Force of Negation, Pact of Negation, Fierce Guardianship), Mana Drain, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift.
value.mana: Fast mana (Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Ancient Tomb, Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual) or the reanimation route.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Every copy, reanimation and mill-doubler exists to multiply Xander's three triggers, and his attack is half of two Spellbook infinites.
accepted_role.honest_note: Seven mana, so the deck relies on reanimation and clones to make him realistic. Halving rounds down, so an odd library leaves one card (M1 xander-05). Guildmage + Mindcrank, Monument/Bruvac + Cacophony, Sword + Assault and Breach all win without him.

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?
